scope: Substantive selected-source integration patches and headless harness; no frozen-source changes, live reads/controls, system/desktop/GRUB changes or full kernel/Mesa builds.
implemented: Selected OF chip profile now flows through probe, DRM registration, bootstrap and platform construction. Each donor initialization constructor checks an explicit T8132-only selector before its resource operations.

Pure kernel Topology separates logical slots from enabled cores, validates chip/variant and exact cluster mask count, preserves explicit masks, rejects absent/empty/out-of-range masks, and never substitutes a captured board mask. GET_PARAMS consumes the runtime-bound topology instead of hardcoded G/0x8132/one-cluster identity. Revision continues to come from the existing raw ID read.

Platform hardware-data chip binding now follows the selected topology; donor builders still accept only T8132. T6040 metadata and pure topology are supported, but its normal runtime path remains refused until a native implementation exists.

Mesa decodes complete G16 chip/die/variant/cluster/logical-slot/mask identity immediately after GET_PARAMS, including rejection of nonzero trailing masks. The G16S packet/layout refusal now happens before VM creation and host heap/mutex allocation.

A linked but unexecuted headless GBM/EGL GLES3 harness requires an explicit Asahi render node, complete captured J614s T6040/B1 identity, hardware Apple M4 Pro/G16S renderer, two bounded GL completion waits and two different full RGBA8 triangle/background readbacks. It also tests exported native EGL fences when advertised and writes captures exclusively.

qualification.leak_sanitizer: Disabled: thread inspection is unsupported in this execution environment. Pure header/criteria tests do not allocate heap storage; address/undefined checks remain enabled.

preserved_failure.reason: LeakSanitizer thread-inspection failure in execution environment; Qv2 disables only leak inspection for heap-free pure C tests, retains address and undefined checks. Original logs/result and 11 kit input snapshots are preserved.

remaining_critical_gaps: Implement and qualify the actual T6040 initialization/power/application command and completion contract before normal startup; constructor gating intentionally remains closed.

Bind multi-cluster boot inputs and live fuse/topology identity to the T6040 runtime. Pure metadata acceptance is not that live binding. Current donor platform still consumes its single-cluster, eleven-row property format.

Qualify G16S TA/3D scene, firmware work, tiling/resource and Apple9 shader-entry/graphics layout deltas, then update Mesa execution selection with those proven layouts. No packet fields were guessed or render gate lifted.
Compile the patched normal DRM module and Mesa in isolated builds. Root may overlay the five Linux files on an isolated copy of the Asahi module directory for a targeted external-module compile.

With a functioning runtime and reviewed loaded kernel/Mesa identities, run the explicit headless harness once to establish real renderer/fence/pixel evidence. Offline CPU acceptance fixtures and a linked harness are not that proof.

Desktop presentation still requires formats/modifiers, dma-buf import or a viable copy path, fences and compositor device selection; KWin software overrides and native DCP integration remain untouched.
hardware_smoke_provenance: The future hardware owner must pin the loaded kernel/Mesa and capture environment, excluding software or DRM-shim/preload substitution. Renderer strings and synthetic offline fixtures alone do not prove hardware. Native fence export support is reported separately and is not implied by a GL fence.
not_attempted: Driver installation or hardware harness execution
